species: nematode (Caenorhabditis elegans, N2 wild type and mutants)
readout_other: worm centre-of-mass tracking; response probability, crawling speed and acceleration
direction_notes: Amplitude-modulated ultrasound evoked reversal behaviour, strongest at modulation frequencies around 1 kHz; the unmodulated carrier did not, and mec-4 mutants responded weakly.
safety_notes: Agar temperature was monitored by thermocouple and stayed near 18.85 C in a single-R run; a thermotaxis-deficient mutant responded like wild type.

exposures.label: 8.8 MHz surface-acoustic-wave stimulation with single and double amplitude modulation

target.label: C. elegans moving on an agar slice (whole body exposed)

device.model: interdigital transducer on 128-degree Y-X LiNbO3 (SAW device), 8.80 MHz central frequency

timing.protocol_description: The 8.80 MHz carrier was amplitude modulated by rectangular or sinusoidal envelopes at modulation frequencies of 0.05 to 311 kHz (single-AM), or by two envelopes (double-AM, second at 1.00 kHz). Each worm received ten 200-ms exposures at 1-min intervals.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: By loading surface acoustic waves (SAWs) onto free-moving worms on an agar surface, a carrier wave with a frequency of 8.80 MHz is selected.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: The final signal sequence is equivalent to a pulsed signal of DC = 50 %
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Every nematode is subjected to 200-ms ultrasonic exposures ten times at an interval of 1 min.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: The effective acoustic pressure in the agar is estimated as about $p _ { e } = 0 . 5 \pm 0 . 1 \ \mathrm { M P a }$ wherep<sub>e</sub> $= \sqrt { 2 } \pi \rho _ { 0 } c _ { 0 } f _ { c } x _ { a } ,$ ρ<sub>0</sub> and $c _ { 0 }$ are the density and speed of sound in water, respectively.

flags.reason: Pressure is a rough estimate in agar derived from laser-vibrometer substrate displacement assuming water properties; the authors call it only a rough estimation. Domain not clearly free-field or in situ.
Values are the modulation frequencies fm1 (Table 1), listed as the PRF equivalent for rectangular modulation; for sinusoidal modulation there are no discrete pulses.
50 % applies to the single rectangular (single-R) protocol only; sinusoidal and double-AM have different envelopes.
Not stated; protocol is amplitude modulation of a carrier.
Worm numbers appear only in figure brackets, not in text.
